name: Board refresh
responsibility: Decides which readings a report makes stale, under every name the tab asked a board by, and in what order
description: Callers report what happened: a board changed, boards of a vault were written or let go, a listing may have moved, a vault's policy changed, the socket came back or a person asked for everything again. Reads in flight are cancelled first, so an answer decided before the event never lands as fresh, then a board's document is marked before its pictures, because a picture reads its board the moment it is asked for again. A reading asked by another spelling of the board, or by a name it had before a rename, is read again too.

outgoing.label: every reading the tab holds, and the names it asked by
